title: Puzzle3d Object Kind Vortices From Kit
description: Puzzle2d Node Kind Vortices From Kit
summary: Object-kind vortex templates from `meta.kindCatalogs` now appear as nested child rows under each object kind in the Puzzle 3D workbench Kinds catalog tab. Labels resolve through the vortex kind catalog; descriptions show local CAD position. Parent object rows stay draggable for palette placement; vortex child rows are read-only.
